title: ReJEPA: Bounded Predictive Regulation for Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent world models learn representations by predicting future states in an abstract embedding space rather than reconstructing raw pixels. When training across multi-frame sequences, however, not all frames and spatial regions are equally informative or predictable. We argue that forcing a world model to minimize every prediction error may be unnecessary and harmful. Under standard $L_2$ loss, unbounded gradients force the encoder and predictor to overfit noisy or transient frames at the expense of core physical structure, while amplifying gradient conflict with representation regularizers. Conversely, $L_1$ loss bounds large gradients, but its constant gradient magnitude near zero disrupts the local smoothness required for planning. translated_title: ReJEPA：面向潜在世界模型的有界预测调节
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型通过在抽象嵌入空间中预测未来状态、而非重建原始像素的方式来学习表示。然而，在多帧序列上进行训练时，并非所有帧和空间区域都具有同等的信息量或可预测性。我们认为，强迫世界模型最小化每一个预测误差可能是既不必要又有害的。在标准的 $L_2$ 损失下，无界的梯度会迫使编码器和预测器过度拟合噪声帧或瞬态帧，从而以牺牲核心物理结构为代价，同时还会加剧与表示正则化项之间的梯度冲突。相反，$L_1$ 损失虽然限制了大梯度，但其在零附近的恒定梯度幅值破坏了规划所需的局部平滑性。我们通过 **ReJEPA** 来化解这一矛盾——这是一种有界预测调节原则，它将大误差时的有界梯度与零附近的平滑二次行为相结合，并简单地通过（后续方法）进行实例化。
tldr: 提出 ReJEPA，一种有界预测调节原则，将大误差的有界梯度与零附近的平滑二次行为相结合，解决了潜在世界模型训练中 L2 损失过拟合噪声帧与 L1 损失破坏局部平滑性的矛盾。
en_tdlr: ReJEPA is a bounded predictive regulation principle that combines bounded gradients for large errors with smooth quadratic behavior near zero, resolving the trade-off between L2 loss overfitting noisy frames and L1 loss disrupting planning smoothness in latent world models.
